steps.en: Build the C library and its vmaf CLI once (or take a prebuilt FFmpeg/Docker binary)
steps.zh: 一次性构建 C 库与 vmaf CLI（或用预编译版）
steps.code: meson setup build --buildtype release · ninja -vC build

steps.en: Hand the CLI a reference and a distorted clip as .y4m or .yuv
steps.zh: 把参考与失真片源（y4m/yuv）交给 CLI

steps.en: Runs the built-in model's feature extractors on every frame pair
steps.zh: 对每一对帧运行内建模型的特征提取器

steps.en: Fuses the features into per-frame and pooled 0-100 scores, written to your log
steps.zh: 把特征融合成逐帧与汇总的 0–100 分，写进日志

component.zh: 模型回归器 + 日志器

value.en: A perceptual 0-100 score per encode, comparable across codecs, presets and resolutions
value.zh: 每个编码一个 0–100 感知分，可在 codec、preset、分辨率之间横向比较
